## Delivery Budget

- Estimate confidence: medium

| ID | Work item | Effort | Architecture delta | Debt claim | Addresses | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| W1 | Proactive mechanical checklist repair and replayable evidence-preserving lineage | 5 | 2 | - | - | One command and one narrow durable lineage kind extending existing Git/RecordStore seams; includes preview, proof, authorization, interrupted-commit recovery, concurrency, and evidence-carry tests. |
| W2 | Shared executability diagnostics and repair-first boundary integration | 3 | 1 | - | - | One shared validation result across parser/authority, CLI inspection, review, admission and completion callers; includes compatibility and false-positive tests. |
| W3 | Final committed approval/ledger reconciliation | 5 | 1 | - | - | One finalization record extending existing completion/binding provenance, including sealed-source compatibility, final-corrections lifecycle and exact-blob tests. |
| W4 | Actionable gate invariant and truthful plan-defect evidence | 3 | 0 | - | - | Repairs existing routing/composition/projection and review context; preserves current finding taxonomy and includes historical-recovery and native/invoke parity tests. |
| W5 | Effective workflow assets and integrated low-friction acceptance | 3 | 0 | - | - | Updates shipped/configured skeletons, prompt variants and skills, then verifies installation/override behavior and the complete incident lifecycle; tests are included here and in W1–W4, not scored separately. |

No debt credit is claimed. The new durable kinds are deliberately limited to mechanical repair and final approval provenance; they reuse the existing journal and index boundaries.

### Surface Snapshot

- Subsystems: 5
- Production files: 38
- Persistent/external boundaries: 2

The subsystems are plan parsing/authority, CLI boundaries, review/approval governance, record projection, and workflow assets. The boundaries are the existing Git object/history boundary and RecordStore JSONL persistence with its derived SQLite index. The production inventory below counts 25 existing TypeScript modules, 3 proposed focused modules, and 10 shipped Markdown prompt/skill assets; the configured repository skeleton and tests are additional. No external service, new SQLite table, parallel workflow engine, or generic override framework is planned.

findings.title: Reconcile workflow assets and preserve the issue-plan contract
findings.failure: Implementing the listed assets can leave actual revision and issue handoffs without repair guidance, reject or expand a valid compact plan, or lose pinned Source brief and verbatim AC coverage during otherwise mechanical recovery.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Update Phase 5, asset matrix, Files Touched and snapshot counts with the actual revision/continued prompts and issue skill Steps 2/3; document unaffected delegation where no edit is needed. Add focused compact-fixture and rendered-asset acceptance preserving one-phase structure, prose gates, Source brief, AC text/mappings, assumptions and snapshots, with only review findings in Addresses. Exercise completed-source finalization/repair into explicit binding and same-implementation-run repair with existing authorization and evidence, without new gates or runs.

findings.title: Verify mechanical receipts through delivery identity and closure
findings.failure: A successful same-run repair could still leave issue delivery unsettled or uncovered and block closure; treating a repair receipt as acceptance could instead allow unsettled phases or unrelated code to reach success publication.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Add precise Phase 5 regressions to issue-resolution-recipes.test.ts and its existing helper using codec-valid new records and plan/record-only commits. Execute the shipped recipes for ordinary settled review and exact proof-bound correction carried across repair, plus finalization-to-binding provenance; preserve accepted code endpoints and require evidence-only receipt commits and delivery: ok without extra review/quality or replacement runs. Retain a negative unsettled/uncovered companion and existing no-success-publication behavior. Modify recipe text only if a concrete incompatibility appears; do not widen ranges/exclusions or add receipt-based approval or closure rules.

baselineAssessment.reason: Independent estimate from Git/journal repair proof, interruption and replay handling, exact committed approval reconciliation and sealed-source compatibility, shared parser and boundary wiring, routing/context repairs, and effective workflow acceptance. Existing folds and paired-store facilities reduce invention, but evidence-preserving cross-boundary recovery dominates effort; integration findings carry separate incremental estimates.
